title: phaseolus vulgaris var. doloensis
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. doloensis, commonly known as the "wild kidney bean," is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. doloensis include its use in treating conditions such as diabetes, obesity, and hypertension, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
